automationPrinciple.target: 99 percent automated operations, 1 percent presidential decision
automationPrinciple.presidentialDecisionRole: Nermin Sefić approves or directly issues strategic, legal, financial, reputational, ownership, security and production-impacting decisions.
automationPrinciple.operatorRole: Operator OS prepares, routes, drafts, checks, records and executes approved workflows under policy limits.

governanceCadence.body: Annual General Assembly / Group Annual Review

governanceCadence.publicOutput: Date, body, general subject and approved public decision summary
Approved public summary only when relevant
Approved local corporate activity summary when appropriate

records.publicTimeline: Shows only approved, confirmed governance activity: date, body, title, public summary, status and public document link when approved.
records.internalMinutes: Full minutes, votes, attachments, source files, drafts and sensitive details remain in the internal Governance Center.
records.auditTrail: Every proposal, decision, edit, approval, rejection and execution receives an immutable record with actor, timestamp, source and linked document.

riskControls: No fictional staff may be presented as real employees.
AI-supported teams must be labelled as Digital Operations Team or Global Operations Center where appropriate.
Public governance records require explicit approval before publication.
Internal records must distinguish proposed, approved and executed decisions.
Rollback path is required before production-impacting changes.
